FillSource.description:
Origin of a fill record.

Broker paper fills and conservative internal shadow fills are stored side
by side and never merged or overwritten, so the two can always be compared.
FillSource.title: FillSource

Side.description:
Order side.

``SELL`` may only reduce or close an existing long position; it can never
open a short. That invariant is enforced by the position-aware risk engine,
not by this enum.
Side.title: Side

description:
An execution against an order.

Fills are append-only. A ``broker_paper`` fill is the record of what the
paper broker actually did; an ``internal_shadow`` fill is the lab's own,
deliberately more pessimistic estimate for the same order. Both are kept.
Shadow fills never overwrite broker fills, and the two are never summed.

recorded_at.description: When the lab stored the fill.
recorded_at.title: Recorded At

schema_version.description: Contract version this record was written under.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

sequence.description: Monotonic index of this fill within its order.
sequence.title: Sequence

source.description: Broker paper fill or internal shadow fill.

title: Fill
